summary: Adds pkg/automation/code, the Code node sandbox: a Compiler (esbuild, imports refused) and an Engine that runs JS/TS in a fresh QuickJS-ng wasm instance per run (github.com/iota-uz/kafig) under a wasm page cap and a context deadline, with Go-validated host calls, NewGuardedFetcher (SSRF policy), secret masking and Declarations for the editor's .d.ts. New dependencies: github.com/iota-uz/kafig/kafig-go, github.com/tetratelabs/wazero, github.com/evanw/esbuild, code.dny.dev/ssrf.
